description:
Batch file renaming utility for Windows and Mac.

Advanced Renamer is a program for renaming multiple files and folders at once. By configuring renaming methods the names can be manipulated in various ways.
It is easy to set up a batch rename using multiple methods on a large amount of files. The 13 different methods enables you to change the names, and timestamps of files in one go. The files can also be copied or moved to new locations based on information in the files.
With Advanced Renamer you can construct new file names by adding, removing, replacing, changing case, or giving the file a brand new name based on known information about the file.
Before performing the operations on the files you can verify that the output will be correct and if you perform the rename and regret it, you can undo the complete batch.
Detailed preview of filename changes

Select an item in the list to see a detailed preview of its changes at the bottom of the main window. The original and new filenames are shown together, with removed text highlighted in red and added text highlighted in blue, to make it easier to see exactly which parts of a filename will change. Any error for the selected item is displayed alongside the filename preview.

When using move or copy mode, the preview also shows the destination folder. If the batch changes file timestamps, the original and new dates are shown with the same highlighting.
If you prefer the extra space, you can hide the preview to get the full view of the file list.

Add correct filename format extension

The new <DetectedExt> tag returns a file extension based on the content of the file. Use it to add missing extensions or correct extensions that do not match the actual file format.

Add a New Name method, set "Apply to" to "Extension", and enter <DetectedExt> as the new name. For example, a PNG image named photo.dat will become photo.png. The tag returns the extension without the dot, just like <Ext>, and always in lowercase. If you prefer your extensions in uppercase, you can use the upper modifier, like this <DetectedExt:upper>.

If the file format cannot be detected from its content, the tag returns the existing filename extension.

UI updates for tag selector

A new Search tab in the tag selector lets you search across all tag categories from one place. Type part of a tag name or description to narrow down the list, then click a result to insert the tag into your naming pattern.

Search also includes project tags, named counters, and metadata fields from the files in the list, including fields normally hidden under "More". The tag selector layout has been updated, with tag names and descriptions shown in different colors to make the list easier to read.

Use external JS files in script method

JavaScript functions can now be kept in external .js files and reused in your Script methods. Open the Project Settings window, select the Script tab, and add the files you want to use.

The external files are loaded in the listed order before the Script method's own code, making their functions available without copying the same code into each method. This is useful for keeping shared formatting functions or more complex renaming logic in one place, and lets you edit that code in your preferred editor.

Full list of changes in version 4.28
- Scripting: Setup external library files in project settings
- Main window: Statusbar showing changes for selected item
- Main window: Added "Move to recycle bin" to the list right click menu
- New name method: Tab for searching through all tags
- New name method: UI improvements
- Timestamp method: Changes to file level timestamps now only applies to the destination file when using move or copy mode
- Tags: New tag <DetectedExt> for returning a file extension based on the content of the file
- Tags: <Date Created> tags did not work on macOS
- Metadata: Made reading metadata from PDF files more reliable
- Metadata: Support for HTML files
- Metadata: Support comic book archive files (CBR, CBZ)
- Metadata: Support metadata from ZIP and RAR archives
- Metadata: Native support for MTS and M2TS files
- Metadata: Native support for more raw image formats
- Metadata: Native support for APE and WV audio formats
- Metadata: Support several legacy formats
- Undo batch: Better error handling for undo batch
- Undo batch: Will now also revert changes to file level timestamps
- Columns window: Column double click an item moves it to the other list
- Thumbnails: Better generation of thumbnails and image previews on macOS
- UI: Changed look and feel for application titlebar on macOS
- Settings: Split the Program tab into Program and User Interface tabs
- Settings: Added "Confirm clear method list" and "Confirm save on project close" options, both enabled by default
- Batch project: Save project would sometimes fail on Windows when the path contained unicode characters
- Better error messages when certain file operations fail on Windows
- Compatibility improvements for the use of regular expressions
- Performance improvements when using <Rand> tag
- Performance improvements when using regular expressions
- Performance improvements when using name collision rules
- Performance improvements when some items are unchecked
- Changed the behavior of unchecked items to not get a new name generated at all
- Prevent batches from being started when no items are selected or no methods are configured and the "Don't show summary before renaming" setting is enabled
- Updated integration to ExifTool
